about.title: Our Story
about.subtitle:
A real story. Real pain. A real mission.
EaseMind was born from a struggle that changed our lives.

origin.title: Where it all began
origin.p1: Before any app, method, or idea existed… there was pain. My wife faced Anxiety and Panic crises so intense that our routine became survival. We sought psychologists, therapists, doctors — and each day felt like a new battle.
origin.p2: But we didn't give up. We walked together, embracing fear, insecurity, sleepless nights, tears that only those who live through this understand.
origin.p3: Over time, healing came. And with it, something even more powerful: purpose.
origin.p4: My wife decided to study and become a Therapist. She wanted to help others not feel alone in the dark as she once did. And I, a programmer, began to realize that technology could also be healing — if used with love, empathy, and truth.
origin.p5: That's how EaseMind was born: not as an app, but as a continuation of our story.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.p1: No one should face anxiety without support. No one should suffer because they can't afford weekly therapy. No one should feel like they're fighting alone.
list: ✨ Accessible — because mental health is a right, not a luxury
✨ Welcoming — because we know exactly how this pain hurts
✨ Effective — cutting-edge technology guiding you with real empathy
mission.p3: This app is not a product. It's the bridge we wished we had found back then.

v1.title: Empathy
v1.desc: Created by those who lived anxiety firsthand — and know what you're feeling.

v2.title: Accessibility
v2.desc: Quality emotional support, at a price that fits anyone's reality.

v3.title: Human innovation
v3.desc: Technology and therapy working together, with one goal: your well-being.

team.title: Who We Are
team.desc: We're a couple who turned pain into purpose. She, a trained therapist with a personal story of overcoming. He, a programmer passionate about creating solutions that truly make a difference.
team.desc2: Together, we created EaseMind so no one has to face alone what we faced. If you're here today, know this: this app was made thinking of you.
team.desc3: You are not alone. You never were. And you never will be.

edu.hero_subtitle: How technology is helping people find balance in a simple and accessible way.
edu.context_p1: In recent years, the fast-paced routine, excessive stimuli, and daily pressure have caused millions of people to feel an impact on their emotional well-being. Often, it's not easy to find someone to talk to, vent, or get guidance at the exact moment when the mind needs it most.
edu.context_p2: At the same time, technology is advancing so fast that it already allows creating calmer, more private, and welcoming spaces — available anytime, right on your phone.
edu.context_p3: This is where a new idea is born: digital emotional support.
edu.what_is_desc: It's when we use technology to:
edu.what_is_5: Provide self-care tools quickly and intuitively
edu.what_is_note: It doesn't replace professionals, it's not treatment, it doesn't promise cures — but it complements daily life, bringing comfort and clarity in moments when the mind feels overwhelmed.
edu.why_important_title: Why has this become so important?
edu.why_important_intro: 3 main reasons explain the evolution of this type of tool:
edu.reason_1_desc: People are more connected than ever — but don't always feel understood. Having someone 'nearby' 24/7 makes a difference.
edu.reason_2_desc: Not everyone can pause their routine to schedule appointments or talk when they need to.
edu.reason_3_desc: Guided breathing, quick meditations, simple mental exercises, and even structured conversations help bring calm in minutes.
edu.easemind_role_title: Where does EaseMind fit into this new reality?
edu.easemind_role_desc: EaseMind was born precisely from this need: a digital emotional wellness tool, made to provide simple, fast, and discreet support.
edu.easemind_for_who: It was created for those seeking:
edu.feature_4: Have an 'emotional guide' in your pocket
edu.feature_5: Learn to deal with daily stress
edu.inside_1_desc: Breathing and relaxation to reduce mental tension.
edu.inside_2_desc: No judgment. Let it out and reorganize your thoughts.
edu.inside_3_desc: Small wellness practices that fit in 2 to 5 minutes.
edu.inside_4_desc: Gentle guidance for moments of emotional overload.
edu.cta_title: Experience digital emotional support in practice
edu.cta_desc: If you want to try and better understand how this new form of support works, access the official page.
edu.disclaimer_text: EaseMind does not replace psychotherapy or health professionals, does not offer diagnosis, and makes no treatment promises. It is a complementary emotional wellness tool, designed to bring calm, clarity, and support in daily life.
